title: Design System: Ravyntech Storefront
scope: Customer storefront only (.sf scope). Admin dashboard keeps default shadcn tokens.

headline.purpose: Product name on the product page.

section.purpose: Section heads over an ink rule; 24px rising to 32px at md.

title.purpose: Sub-section heads, sheet titles, empty states, category index rows (20px).

price-lg.purpose: Product page and featured product price; 30px rising to 36px at md.

price-sm.purpose: Card and row prices (18px medium size in feature cards).

body.purpose: Descriptions and intros, held to a prose measure.

label.purpose: Brand names, stock marks, spec runs, counts, facts strip, footer column heads.

wordmark.purpose: Uppercase Ravyntech wordmark in the header (24px in the footer).

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Search preview dropdown; only floating layers carry shadow.

shadows.name: dock
shadows.purpose: Mobile sticky purchase bar over a 95% surface.

motion.name: nudge
motion.purpose: Arrow in category index rows and "Every ... product" links on hover.

motion.name: field-tint
motion.purpose: Product image field tints to raven-soft on card hover.

motion.name: dock-slide
motion.purpose: Mobile purchase bar slides up when the main CTA leaves view.

motion.name: progress
motion.purpose: Free-delivery progress bar in the cart summary.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

accessibility: Minimum 44px target on every interactive element; buy and checkout buttons 48px.
Focus: 2px solid raven outline at 2px offset (scope default).
State never by colour alone: stock dot plus words, struck label plus "Out of stock", "Was" before struck prices for screen readers.
Skip-to-content link as the first focusable element.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Raven-blue-gray action; 44px minimum, 48px full width for add to cart and checkout.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); color: var(--sf-on-raven, oklch(0.985 0.003 255)); height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 15px/1 "Google Sans", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 100ms, transform 100ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--sf-raven-ink, oklch(0.32 0.02 255)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Pagination and the mobile Filters trigger.
components.html: Next
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--sf-surface, oklch(0.995 0.002 250)); color: var(--sf-ink, oklch(0.19 0.012 255)); border: 1px solid var(--sf-rule-strong, oklch(0.78 0.01 250)); border-radius: 4px; font: 500 14px/1 "Google Sans", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Persistent header search; same field spec as filter and sort inputs.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input type="search" aria-label="Search products" placeholder="Search phones, laptops, brands"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; max-width: 36rem; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 12px; color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px 0 36px; background: var(--sf-surface, oklch(0.995 0.002 250)); color: var(--sf-ink, oklch(0.19 0.012 255)); border: 1px solid var(--sf-rule-strong, oklch(0.78 0.01 250)); border-radius: 4px; font: 400 15px "Google Sans", Arial, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); } .ds-search input:hover { border-color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.47 0.105 162 / 0.25); }

components.name: Category Chips
components.description: Mobile category index rail; the last chip inverts to ink.
components.html: Phones 12Audio 8All 40
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--sf-surface, oklch(0.995 0.002 250)); border: 1px solid var(--sf-rule-strong, oklch(0.78 0.01 250)); color: var(--sf-ink, oklch(0.19 0.012 255)); font: 500 14px "Google Sans", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-chip span { font-size: 12px; color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-all { background: var(--sf-ink, oklch(0.19 0.012 255)); color: var(--sf-paper, oklch(0.968 0.003 250)); border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Header with Facts Strip
components.description: Ink facts strip over the sticky paper header: wordmark, search, account, cart with count.

components.css: .ds-hdr { background: var(--sf-paper, oklch(0.968 0.003 250)); color: var(--sf-ink, oklch(0.19 0.012 255)); font-family: "Google Sans", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-facts { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; height: 36px; margin: 0; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--sf-ink, oklch(0.19 0.012 255)); color: var(--sf-paper, oklch(0.968 0.003 250)); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sf-rule, oklch(0.875 0.007 250)); } .ds-wordmark { margin-right: auto; font: 700 17px/1 Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 125%; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-hbtn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 4px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-hbtn:hover { background: var(--sf-field, oklch(0.935 0.006 250)); } .ds-hbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-count { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 20px; min-width: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); color: var(--sf-on-raven, oklch(0.985 0.003 255)); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; animation: ds-pop 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes ds-pop { from { transform: scale(0.4); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } }

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; width: 220px; font-family: "Google Sans", Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--sf-ink, oklch(0.19 0.012 255)); } .ds-field { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--sf-field, oklch(0.935 0.006 250)); transition: background-color 300ms; } .ds-card:hover .ds-field { background: var(--sf-raven-soft, oklch(0.93 0.012 255)); } .ds-sale { position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--sf-sale, oklch(0.53 0.19 28)); color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-brand { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); } .ds-name { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-name a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; outline: none; } .ds-name a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-name a:focus-visible::after { outline: 2px solid var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-specs { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; margin-top: 6px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--sf-rule, oklch(0.875 0.007 250)); } .ds-price { font: 600 15px Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 112.5%; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-stock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sf-raven-ink, oklch(0.32 0.02 255)); } .ds-stock i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); }

components.name: Variant Selector
components.description: Option tiles; selected gets raven wash and ring, out of stock is struck through.
components.css: .ds-variants { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; font-family: "Google Sans", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-var { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--sf-rule-strong, oklch(0.78 0.01 250)); background: var(--sf-surface, oklch(0.995 0.002 250)); color: var(--sf-ink, oklch(0.19 0.012 255)); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-var b { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-var span { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-var:hover { border-color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); } .ds-var[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); background: var(--sf-raven-soft, oklch(0.93 0.012 255)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); } .ds-var:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sf-raven, oklch(0.402 0.018 255)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-var-out { color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); } .ds-var-out b { text-decoration: line-through; }

components.name: Spec Ledger
components.description: Signature move: ruled two-column datasheet of terms and values with tabular figures.
components.css: .ds-ledger { max-width: 32rem; font-family: "Google Sans", Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--sf-ink, oklch(0.19 0.012 255)); } .ds-ledger h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 600 18px Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 112.5%; } .ds-ledger dl { margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--sf-ink, oklch(0.19 0.012 255)); font-size: 14px; } .ds-ledger dl > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(7rem, 38%) 1fr; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sf-rule, oklch(0.875 0.007 250)); } .ds-ledger dt { color: var(--sf-ink-2, oklch(0.46 0.014 255)); } .ds-ledger dd { margin: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger .ds-fig { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-stretch: 112.5%; } .ds-ledger .ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; }

narrative.overview:
The shop reads like a well-made product datasheet: exact, calm, measured. Every surface is a sheet of cool paper ruled with hairlines, set in a wide engineering display face, with near-black ink for facts and a single raven-mask blue-gray for the things you act on. Information is the decoration. Prices, stock, delivery fees, warranty terms and payment methods are set as real, ruled facts rather than being hidden behind banners, and nothing is shown that the data does not back.

Density is moderate and even, tuned for phones in bright light on slow networks: generous 44px targets, short line lengths, no heavy imagery beyond the product photos themselves, which sit on tinted fields so a mixed catalogue of white-background shots reads as one set. The world explicitly rejects the category default of a decorative hero banner over identical card grids; the home page opens on a wide headline, a ruled category index and one real product at full scale.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground, near-black ink, one raven-blue-gray accent; sale red only on real discounts.
Archivo set wide (125% / 112.5% width) for headings, prices and model names; Google Sans for everything read.
Tabular figures everywhere in the storefront scope.
Hairline rules instead of boxes; a heavier ink rule opens each section.
The spec ledger: ruled two-column term/value rows, echoed as a one-line spec run under every product card.
Product photos always on a tinted field, never on bare paper.

rules.name: The One Blue-Gray Rule
rules.body: Raven blue-gray marks what you can act on or what is selected, and nothing else. Headings, borders and decoration stay ink and hairline.

rules.name: The Real Discount Rule
rules.body: Sale red appears only when the current price is below a stored original price. No red for "hot", "limited" or countdowns.

rules.name: The Scoped Palette Rule
rules.body: Storefront colour comes from the `--sf-*` tokens through the `.sf` scope, which re-points the shadcn tokens (`--primary`, `--border`, `--ring` ...) so shared primitives inherit the world. Never hard-code storefront colours into shared components, and never let `--sf-*` leak into the admin dashboard.

rules.name: The Wide Figures Rule
rules.body: Numbers that matter (prices, delivery fees, thresholds) are set in Archivo semi-expanded with tabular figures. All other storefront numbers are tabular by inheritance from `.sf`.

rules.name: The Width-Not-Weight Rule
rules.body: Emphasis climbs by width (100% → 112.5% → 125%) before it climbs by weight. Nothing in the storefront goes above 700.

rules.name: The Facts-First Rule
rules.body: Delivery fees, the free-delivery threshold and payment methods are visible before checkout on every page: in the facts strip, on the product page terms ledger, on the home ledger and in the footer. All values are read live from settings, never typed in.

rules.name: The Ruled-Not-Boxed Rule
rules.body: Group content with hairlines (top/bottom rules, divided lists), not with bordered or shadowed cards. A product card has no frame: image field, then text, then a hairline over the price row.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this is above the page right now." Resting surfaces never carry one.

dos: Do scope every storefront page under `.sf` and take colour from the `--sf-*` roles (via `bg-paper`, `text-ink-2`, `border-rule`, `bg-raven` ...).
Do give every interactive element a 44px minimum target (`h-11` / `min-h-11`); buy and checkout buttons are 48px.
Do rely on the scope's focus ring: 2px solid raven outline, 2px offset. When a control replaces it (inputs), use a raven border plus a 2px 25% raven ring.
Do set facts as a spec ledger (ruled term/value rows with tabular figures) and under products as a one-line " · " spec run.
Do put every product photo on the Photo Field with `object-contain` and an inset, and show the "Photo coming soon" plate with the brand set wide when there is no photo.
Do set prices with the Price component: wide Archivo, tabular, no wrap between "Tk" and the amount, struck original with a screen-reader "Was".
Do open sections with a heading over an ink rule and separate them by 64px / 96px.
Do pair every state colour with words or shape (stock dot plus "In stock", strike plus "Out of stock").
donts: Don't add a decorative hero banner or a carousel; the home page opens on a headline, the category index and one real product.
Don't show invented proof, counts, delivery times, stock numbers or discounts; every fact on the page is read from data or settings.
Don't use raven blue-gray for headings, borders or decoration, and don't use sale red for anything except a real price reduction or a validation error.
Don't wrap groups in bordered or shadowed cards where a hairline will do; shadows belong only to floating layers.
Don't set prices or model names in the body face, or push Archivo past 700 weight.
Don't put product photos on bare paper or crop them to fill.
Don't apply the `--sf-*` palette or `.sf` overrides to the admin dashboard.
